description: Anything in a person's home, as every part of ohm reads it: a block, a channel, the profile and its wallet, an agent's observation, skill, tool or memory, or a file of the site. The file stays where it is and its own reader keeps its rules; a unit is the envelope they all return. Blocks and channels keep their own records (com.ohmmmm.vault.block, com.ohmmmm.vault.channel), named by nsid. Units are read from the home's folder and never written to a PDS; publishing a block makes a com.ohmmmm.post.

key.description: Names the unit across the home. A block or a channel keeps its node key (block:<id>, channel:<id or path>); a wallet is wallet:<address>; any other unit is <root>:<path>.

kind.description: What the unit is within its type: a block's kind (text, link, media, …), a channel's kind, or an artifact's (page, image, video, audio, document, data).

nsid.description: The lexicon of the unit's own record: com.ohmmmm.vault.block, com.ohmmmm.vault.channel, or com.ohmmmm.unit for a unit with no record of its own.

root.description: The part of the home the unit is in, as people see it.

path.description: The unit's file, from the top of the home, such as collections/writing/collisions.md. A wallet's is its profile's.

id.description: The unit's own ID when it has one: a block's or a channel's TID, an observation's ID, a skill's or a tool's name, a wallet's address.

visibility.description: Who may see it. A block says its own; the profile, the wallet and the site are public; agents' files are private.

channels.description: The channels the unit is in, home channel first. For a channel, its parent.

by.description: Who made it: me, or agent:<name>.

origin.description: Where the original lives when it is not this file.

updated.description: When it last changed: the file's own updated property, or else when the file was last written.
